description: Source code for a firmware utility tool for TP-Link devices, including structures for firmware headers, functions for inspecting and building firmware images, and command-line option parsing.

classes.name: fw_header
classes.description: Represents the firmware header structure with versioning, hardware info, and offsets.

classes.name: board_info
classes.description: Contains information about hardware board configurations.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates command-line options and input files.

methods.name: fill_header
methods.description: Fills a buffer with firmware header data based on current configuration.

methods.name: inspect_fw
methods.description: Inspects a firmware file, verifies header, and optionally extracts components.
